inlines.v: IG'NORANTLY, adverb Without knowledge, instruction or information. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you. Acts 17:23. 1. Unskillfully; inexpertly. A man may mistake blunders for beauties and ignorantly admire them.
